title: Seating Conflict Hotspots
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:rsvp seating_conflict=yes
| stats count as conflicts by table_name conflict_type
| sort - conflicts
description: Ranks tables and conflict types where seating constraints keep colliding.
value: Seating plans get hard because conflicts cluster, and hotspot analysis helps fix the worst tables first.
implementation: Tag seating conflicts in RSVP or seating-tool exports; count them by table and conflict type.
visualization: Heatmap table of seating conflicts by table and type.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks where the seating plan keeps running into the same kinds of people-placement problems.
